roles.anyone: Anyone with a funded wallet. Pays only the transaction fee (and rent where noted); chooses no amounts.
roles.mint_keypair: The holder of the new mint's keypair — the launchpad, inside the token's create flow. Usable exactly once per mint.
roles.creator: The creator wallet recorded at init. Holds no power by itself; it is the initial config authority.
roles.config_authority: TokenConfig.admin — initially the creator; can be renounced forever (renounce_admin). Powers: attester set only.
roles.attesters: The quorum (N of M) of attester ed25519 keys named in the TokenConfig — kind-tagged operator / zktls-relayer / oracle (informational). Each signs (feed, period, value, sha256 of the source URL, zkTLS proof locator); the program verifies only signatures and the quorum.
roles.upgrade_authority: The program's upgrade authority (BPF Upgradeable Loader). At launch: the Squads 2-of-3 vault with a 48 h time lock; set to none after the audit.
roles.platform_authority: PlatformConfig.authority — intended: the Squads 2-of-3 vault. Power: RAISE the temporary burn-pool cap (48 h timelock). Renounceable; the cap sunsets by itself.
roles.attester_key: Any ONE key of the token's CURRENT attester set, signing a transaction by itself (no quorum). Power: veto (clear) a pending registration-policy proposal — nothing else (re-check R3-2).
roles.platform_authority_or_listed_cranker: PlatformConfig.authority (while not renounced) OR any key on the PlatformConfig's cranker allowlist (re-check R3-4). Power: clear the allowlist (back to permissionless) — never add a key.

instructions.name: apply_attester_change
instructions.can: Apply a pending attester proposal after its 48-hour timelock.
instructions.cannot: Apply early; apply a proposal that lowers the quorum (re-checked).
instructions.timelock: Executable only after the proposal's ETA.

instructions.name: apply_cap_raise
instructions.can: Apply a pending cap raise after its 48-hour timelock.
instructions.cannot: Apply early; apply anything but a raise (re-checked).
instructions.timelock: Executable only after the proposal's ETA.

instructions.name: apply_registration_policy
instructions.can: Apply a pending registration-policy switch after its 48-hour timelock and before it expires (14 days after the proposal), re-checking the window and (fixed pool) the creator + LP checks and the 90 %-or-LaunchLab-config rule.
instructions.cannot: Apply early, after expiry, after the cap sunset, while a pool works, or a pool that fails the checks.
instructions.timelock: Executable only after the proposal's ETA.

instructions.name: cancel_attester_change
instructions.can: Withdraw a pending attester proposal.
instructions.cannot: Anything else.

instructions.name: cancel_cap_raise
instructions.can: Withdraw a pending cap raise.
instructions.cannot: Anything else.

instructions.name: cancel_registration_policy
instructions.can: Withdraw a pending registration-policy switch.
instructions.cannot: Anything else.

instructions.name: check_pool_health
instructions.can: Record an observation of the registered pool being untradeable (swaps disabled, pool account gone, or < 0.01 SOL WSOL reserve) — a spell starts on the second of two observations ≥ 1 h apart and is continuous only while observations are ≤ 24 h apart — or clear the record when it is tradeable again.
instructions.cannot: Change the pool; move funds; backdate the record; run inside another program's instruction (CPI — it must be top-level, stack height 1); run in a transaction with any other instruction touching the pool (a CPMM instruction, or one listing the pool, either vault or its observation account). Residual: a Jito bundle of separate transactions is invisible to it (README "Pool health").

instructions.name: claim_launchlab_creator_fee
instructions.can: CPI LaunchLab claim_creator_fee with the fee PDA (the LaunchLab creator) signing, the recipient pinned to the fee PDA's own WSOL account; adds the curve creator fee to the burn pool.
instructions.cannot: Send the fee anywhere else; take lamports from the fee PDA, WSOL from its WSOL account or tokens from its token account; change the fee PDA's owner/data or its token accounts' owner, mint, delegate or close authority (all re-checked after the CPI, hard errors); pass any extra account; target any program but LaunchLab.
instructions.funds: LaunchLab creator vault (fee PDA, WSOL) → the fee PDA's WSOL account.

instructions.name: claim_lock_fees
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35: collect ALL the recorded position's accrued fees (no caller-chosen amount: lp-lock blind review L-3; against the FeeKeyRecord's pool, so a pool replacement cannot strand them: L-1) from Raydium's CPMM lock program (collect_cp_fees, signed by the FEE_KEYS PDA, into FEE_KEYS's own WSOL and token accounts) and split them by compiled constants: the SOL side 80 % (LOCK_FEE_BURN_BPS) to the coin's fee PDA (its burn pool) and 20 % (LOCK_FEE_OPERATOR_BPS) to the compiled OPERATOR_TREASURY; burn the coin side in the same instruction; write a receipt memo (v2: with the operator share delivered and still pending) when SOL was claimed or delivered; FEE_KEYS's transient accounts are closed with their rent back to the cranker who created them (a pre-existing account's rent goes to the fee PDA).
instructions.cannot: Choose the split, the treasury or any recipient (the treasury is compiled per cluster; the mainnet placeholder refuses every claim); claim another coin's position or pool; touch the LP principal (the lock program pays only accrued fees) or the Fee Key (re-checked after the CPI, hard error); let the lock program change FEE_KEYS's owner, data or lamports or its accounts' owner, mint, delegate or close authority; claim while the pre-audit cap is in force if a cranker allowlist exists and the cranker is not on it.
instructions.funds: Raydium lock (accrued LP fees) → FEE_KEYS → fee PDA (80 % of the SOL) and OPERATOR_TREASURY (20 %); the coin side is burned.

instructions.name: clear_cranker_allowlist
instructions.can: Return crank_buyback to permissionless (clear the PlatformConfig's cranker allowlist). Re-check R3-4: the platform authority OR any allowlisted key may do it, so lost keys plus a renounced authority never pin cranking to the list.
instructions.cannot: Add or change crankers; touch the cap, any token or any funds; be done by a key that is neither the authority nor on the list.
instructions.sunset: Pointless once the allowlist stops applying (cap sunset or 90 days after initialize_platform, whichever is first).

instructions.name: crank_buyback
instructions.can: Process the next reading in line (buyback mode): target = pool × (1 − (1 − f)^units) + carried spend; spend at most 2 % of the pool's WSOL reserve (rest carried); swap on the registered, provenance-checked CPMM pool behind a mandatory TWAP guard (≤ 3 % over 600–1,200 s) with a minimum output of max(spot quote, TWAP quote) less ≤ 3 % slippage; burn EVERY token the fee PDA holds; write memo v2. After 30 days of continuous pool untradeability, process the reading below-floor with its target carried. A PAIRED coin (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40) cranks only with the period's pair result: won or draw → as above; no result → only 72 h after the reading (then as an unpaired coin).
instructions.cannot: Choose the amount, the pool, the price or the recipient; skip a reading; process one twice; send SOL or tokens anywhere except the pool (SOL→token) and the burn; let the CPMM call change the fee PDA's or its token accounts' owner, delegate or close authority (hard error); crank while the pre-audit cap is in force if a PlatformConfig cranker allowlist exists and the cranker is not on it; burn for a paired coin that LOST the period (its fuel goes to the winner through forward_to_winner).
instructions.funds: Fee PDA SOL → its WSOL account → CPMM pool vault; tokens received → burned (supply reduced).

instructions.name: crank_no_units
instructions.can: Mark the next-in-line reading with zero units as processed (keeps the queue moving).
instructions.cannot: Touch a reading with units; move any funds.

instructions.name: crank_vault
instructions.can: Process the next reading in line (vault mode): burn units × tokens_per_unit (+ carried shortfall, capped by the allocation) from the program-owned vault; record the public shortfall; write memo v1.
instructions.cannot: Choose the amount; transfer vault tokens anywhere; skip or repeat a reading.
instructions.sunset: Ends when the vault allocation is used up.

instructions.name: forward_to_winner
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40: for a period whose result names a winner, process the LOSER's reading by moving exactly what its own rule would have spent had it won — pool × (1 − (1 − f)^units) on min(spendable, the burn-pool cap), nothing under its floor — from the loser's fee PDA to the winner's fee PDA (SOL above the reserve first, then WSOL into the winner fee PDA's WSOL account); mark the reading forwarded, record the forward on the result, write memo `<PREFIX>|forward|…|v1`. A second call is a no-op.
instructions.cannot: Choose the amount or the recipient (only the winner's fee PDA, which spends only through crank_buyback); forward on a draw, to the losing coin, for coins not paired, out of the loser's reading order, below the loser's reserve, or when either coin has no verified pool (a voided side forwards nothing); touch either coin's supply; run while the pre-audit cap is in force if a cranker allowlist exists and the cranker is not on it.
instructions.funds: Loser fee PDA SOL / WSOL → winner fee PDA SOL / WSOL account (then burned by the winner's cranks).

instructions.name: initialize_platform
instructions.can: Create the ONE PlatformConfig: the platform authority, the burn-pool cap (exactly the 25 SOL default), the cap's sunset time (at most 365 days out and no later than the default sunset, 2027-10-01) and an optional cranker allowlist (≤ 3 keys, applies only while the cap is in force and for at most 90 days).
instructions.cannot: Run twice; be run by anyone but the program's upgrade authority; set any cap but the default (it can only be raised afterwards); set a sunset in the past, beyond 365 days or after 2027-10-01; add crankers later.

instructions.name: initialize_token
instructions.can: Create the ONE TokenConfig of a mint: the burn rule (immutable thereafter), the feed id, the memo text, the rules-file hash, the attester set and quorum; fund the fee PDA with the rule's reserve; for buyback policies 0 and 2, read and PIN the LaunchLab platform — only the operator's compiled BURNTICKER_PLATFORM (per cluster; the mainnet placeholder refuses: lp-lock blind review RL-3) — (its cpConfigId; platformCpCreator must be unset or the fee PDA) and, for policy 0, require it to lock 100 % of the migrated LP with the Fee Key to the program's FEE_KEYS PDA (platformLockNftWallet = FEE_KEYS, platformScale 1,000,000, creator and burn scale 0 — LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35). Optionally (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40, policies 0/1) name the partner mint of a winner-takes-the-burn pair: the coin's PairLink is written provisional, and both coins become paired only if the partner's initialize_token names this mint back within 7 days (an unanswered coin stays a plain coin for good).
instructions.cannot: Run twice for a mint; be run by anyone without the mint keypair; change anything afterwards.
instructions.funds: Payer → fee PDA: the reserve only (rent for the PDA).

instructions.name: link_pair
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40: pair the two coins of a pair_curve Pair (the Pair account — pair_curve's, not Voided — names both mints; both TokenConfigs are policy 2): write or complete both coins' PairLink ["pair_link", mint] and set both configs paired. Idempotent; the payer pays the PairLink rent.
instructions.cannot: Pair coins the Pair does not name, a voided pair, a coin already linked to another partner, or non-policy-2 coins; unpair; change a partner.

instructions.name: propose_attesters
instructions.can: Propose a new attester set and quorum (add, rotate or remove attesters; quorum ≤ 3).
instructions.cannot: Lower the quorum; leave fewer attesters than the quorum; keep fewer than `quorum` current keys or add as many new keys as the new quorum (new keys alone can never sign); add keys unless ≥ `quorum` kept keys have been in the set ≥ 7 days; take effect before 48 hours; touch the rule, readings, fee PDA, vault or pool.
instructions.timelock: 48 hours (ATTESTER_TIMELOCK_SECS = 172,800), public: emits AttesterChangeProposed with the added and removed entries.

instructions.name: propose_cap_raise
instructions.can: Propose RAISING the burn-pool cap (the rule then spends on min(pool, new cap)).
instructions.cannot: Lower the cap or keep it equal; take effect before 48 hours; extend the sunset; touch any token's rule, readings, fee PDA, vault or pool; move funds.
instructions.sunset: Pointless after the cap's sunset (the cap no longer applies); gone once renounce_platform_authority runs.

instructions.name: register_fee_key
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35: once per mint, record the coin's permanent LP lock — the Raydium CPMM lock program's LockedCpLiquidityState (owner, discriminator, PDA ["locked_liquidity", nft]) whose Fee Key NFT (supply 1, no mint or freeze authority) the program's FEE_KEYS PDA holds, identified by its LOCKER (state @128; lp-lock blind review RL-2): policy 0 — the token's LaunchLab migration pool (PDA of the pinned cpConfigId, fee-PDA creator) locked by LaunchLab's vault authority, BEFORE register_pool; policy 2 — the verified pair pool locked by the pair's vault; policy 1 — the verified pool. The position must hold a strict majority of the LP in Raydium's lock account for the LP mint. Recorded in a FeeKeyRecord ["fee_key", mint]; the payer pays its rent.
instructions.cannot: Register a position of another pool, a position locked by anyone but the pool's own locker, a minority of the lock account (so a dust or squatter lock cannot take the slot — and a deposit cannot dilute the coin's own position), a position whose Fee Key FEE_KEYS does not hold, or a second position; change the record; move any funds or the Fee Key.

instructions.name: register_pair_pool
instructions.can: Registration policy 2 (2026-10-10, rivalry pairs): record the CPMM pool that the pair_curve program's graduate created for this token — the Pair account is pair_curve's (hard-coded id, discriminator, PDA ["pair", mint_a, mint_b]), Graduated (or Graduating with this side done) and names this mint; the pool is the one the Pair records for that side AND the pair_curve PDA ["pool", pair, [side]] (only pair_curve can sign for it), on the cpConfigId pinned at initialize_token, with the pair's SOL vault PDA as pool_creator; ≥ 90 % of the LP that existed at creation was LOCKED by pair_curve's lock_lp (or burned, for pairs graduated before LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35) — Pair record, confirmed on chain by the LP in Raydium's lock account plus CPMM lp_supply − LP mint supply.
instructions.cannot: Register a pool for a policy-0/1 token, a pool from another pair or side, a pool at any other address, on another AmmConfig or with its LP neither locked nor burned; register a coin not yet paired by link_pair (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40: every pair is winner-takes-the-burn); register twice; change a registered pool. Later LP deposits cannot block it (the ratio is against the creation supply).

instructions.name: register_pool
instructions.can: Record the Raydium CPMM pool the buyback trades on (pool policy 0) — only LaunchLab's migration pool: the token's LaunchLab pool records the fee PDA as creator, CPMM migration and the platform PINNED at init, the pool is the PDA of the PINNED cpConfigId and the two mints, its pool_creator is the fee PDA, ≥ 50 % of its live LP is burned or held by Raydium's LP lock, and (lp-lock blind review RL-3) the mint's FeeKeyRecord exists for this pool — so the pool is verified only when its LP fees reach the burn. Policy 1: verify the fixed pool (fee-PDA creator, ≥ 50 % LP burned/locked) before any buyback.
instructions.cannot: Register any other pool (another AmmConfig, a random-keypair pool, a pool whose LP its creator can withdraw); register a policy-0 pool whose migration Fee Key FEE_KEYS does not hold (no FeeKeyRecord); register twice; change a registered pool.

instructions.name: renounce_admin
instructions.can: Give up the config authority forever (and cancel any pending proposal). Irreversible.
instructions.cannot: Be undone.

instructions.name: renounce_platform_authority
instructions.can: Give up the platform authority forever (cancels a pending raise). The cap stays as it is until its sunset.
instructions.cannot: Be undone.

instructions.name: replace_pool
instructions.can: After ≥ 7 days of CONTINUOUS recorded untradeability (observations ≤ 24 h apart; the old pool still untradeable), register a DIFFERENT tradeable pool that passes every register_pool check for the LaunchLab platform's current cpConfigId.
instructions.cannot: Pick a pool that fails register_pool's provenance checks; act before 7 continuous days; replace a pool that has been shown tradeable since; act on a fixed-pool (policy 1) token; run under CPI or beside an instruction touching either pool, its vaults or its observation account.

instructions.name: set_registration_policy
instructions.can: STRANDING RECOVERY: propose switching the token's registration policy — to a fixed pool that must pass register_pool's creator + LP checks AND (re-check R3-2) have ≥ 90 % of its live LP burned/locked or be the pool PDA of a LaunchLab-known AmmConfig (the pinned cpConfigId or the pinned platform's current one) when applied, or back to LaunchLab's migration pool (policy 0, needs the pinned platform).
instructions.cannot: Act while a pool works (only with no verified pool, or the registered one continuously untradeable ≥ 7 days); act after the pre-audit cap's sunset; pick a pool whose pool_creator is not the fee PDA, whose LP is < 50 % burned/locked, or (< 90 % locked) that sits on an AmmConfig LaunchLab does not name; take effect before 48 hours or after 14 days (the proposal expires); survive a veto by any one current attester; touch the rule, readings, fee PDA or vault.
instructions.timelock: 48 hours (ATTESTER_TIMELOCK_SECS), public: emits RegistrationPolicyProposed (eta, expires_at = proposal + 14 days); any current attester can veto it (veto_registration_policy).
instructions.sunset: The pre-audit cap's sunset (PlatformConfig.cap_sunset_ts, or 2027-10-01 without one); gone once renounce_admin runs.

instructions.name: submit_pair_result
instructions.can: LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40: append one period's result of a pair — the winning mint or a draw — valid only with a quorum of EACH coin's attesters over BURNRECEIPTS-PAIR-v1 ‖ cluster genesis ‖ program ‖ both mints ‖ date ‖ winner ‖ source hash ‖ proof locator.
instructions.cannot: Change or replace a recorded result; post a result for coins that are not paired to each other, a future date, or a winner outside the pair; reuse a signature made for another cluster, pair or date.
instructions.funds: Payer pays the PairResult account's rent (kept forever).

instructions.name: submit_reading
instructions.can: Append a reading (record_date, value, source_url_hash, proof_hash) — valid only with a quorum (≤ 3) of attester signatures over cluster genesis ‖ program id ‖ mint ‖ feed ‖ previous date ‖ those fields; computes units with the carry rule; an out-of-bound reading is recorded as a 0-unit RESET (new baseline).
instructions.cannot: Edit, delete or replace a written reading; insert a date at or before the last one; reuse a signature made for another cluster, token, deployment or previous reading; post a future date.
instructions.funds: Payer pays the reading account's rent (kept forever; readings are never closed).

instructions.name: veto_registration_policy
instructions.can: VETO: clear a pending registration-policy proposal (re-check R3-2 — the cheap veto by the parties a pool switch would bypass).
instructions.cannot: Propose, apply or change any policy; touch the attester set, readings, rule or funds; act without a pending proposal. (The admin can propose again at once — a fresh, public 48 h.)
instructions.sunset: Pointless once the switch window closes (cap sunset) or renounce_admin runs.

temporary_powers.effect: While in force, each token's buyback spend is computed on min(pool, cap); SOL above the cap stays in the fee PDA and a BurnPoolCapBound event is emitted every time the cap binds.
temporary_powers.can_change: Raise only, through propose_cap_raise → 48 h → apply_cap_raise.
temporary_powers.sunset: PlatformConfig.cap_sunset_ts — set once at initialize_platform (at most 365 days out and no later than 2027-10-01), never extendable; after it the program ignores the cap. Also ends early in effect if the authority raises it to u64::MAX.
temporary_powers.why: A pre-audit limit on how much SOL any single burn day can push through an unaudited program (owner decision, 2026-10-09).

temporary_powers.holder: set once by the upgrade authority at initialize_platform; clearable (never extendable) by platform_authority or by any listed key
temporary_powers.effect: While the cap is in force and the list is non-empty, only listed keys (≤ 3) may crank_buyback — against an outside cranker timing a multi-block TWAP hold. Readings, vault cranks, claims and health checks stay permissionless.
temporary_powers.can_change: clear_cranker_allowlist only (back to permissionless), by the platform authority or any listed key.
temporary_powers.sunset: PlatformConfig.cap_sunset_ts or PlatformConfig.created_at + 90 days, whichever is first (re-check R3-4); afterwards crank_buyback is permissionless whatever the list says.
temporary_powers.why: Against a multi-block TWAP hold timed by an outside cranker while the program is unaudited. If every listed key is lost and the authority renounced, buy-back cranks wait at most 90 days from initialize_platform (no funds move in the meantime).

temporary_powers.effect: Switch a token whose LaunchLab migration cannot be registered (or whose pool died) to a fixed pool passing the creator + LP checks, or back to policy 0.
temporary_powers.can_change: set_registration_policy → 48 h → apply_registration_policy (anyone) within 14 days of the proposal; cancel_registration_policy (admin); veto_registration_policy (any one current attester). A fallback fixed pool needs ≥ 90 % LP burned/locked or a LaunchLab-known AmmConfig (re-check R3-2).
temporary_powers.sunset: The pre-audit cap's sunset (PlatformConfig.cap_sunset_ts, or 2027-10-01 without one); also gone at renounce_admin.
temporary_powers.why: LaunchLab is closed source; its platform admin can change cpConfigId / platformCpCreator / lock scales before migration. Real LaunchLab behaviour remains a devnet-rehearsal gate.

non_powers: No withdraw, sweep, transfer, close or set-recipient instruction exists for the fee PDA, its token accounts, the vault or any program account. SOL leaves the fee PDA only inside crank_buyback (into its own WSOL account, then into the CPMM pool for tokens that are burned) and inside forward_to_winner (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §40: only to the paired winner's fee PDA, only the formula amount for an attested lost period); tokens leave only by burn.

No program account (TokenConfig, Reading, PlatformConfig, FeeKeyRecord, fee PDA) is ever closed. The only accounts the program closes are the FEE_KEYS PDA's own transient WSOL and token accounts inside claim_lock_fees, created and emptied in the same instruction, their rent back to the cranker who paid it (to the fee PDA if someone else created them).

No pause or freeze exists. Nothing can stop cranks except the rule's own guards (a stale TWAP or a closed pool defers a burn day; it is never lost). The burn-pool cap limits how much of a pool one burn day may spend on; it never stops a burn.
No instruction mints tokens, and none holds a mint authority: the program's only token instructions are Burn (and SyncNative on its own WSOL account). There is no team allocation in the program.

No fee is charged by the program, so there is no fee to change. The LP-fee split of claim_lock_fees (80 % burn pool / 20 % operator) and the operator treasury are compiled constants: no instruction, config field or key changes them (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35).
No instruction moves the locked LP principal or the Fee Key NFT: the lock is Raydium's permanent lock, and FEE_KEYS signs only collect_cp_fees inside claim_lock_fees.
No instruction updates the burn rule (RuleParams), the feed id, the memo text, the rules hash, the mint, the creator record or the registered pool.
No instruction edits or deletes a reading; readings are append-only and quorum-checked.

The quorum can never be lowered (nor exceed 3), the attester set can never be smaller than the quorum, and one proposal must keep at least `quorum` of the current keys and add fewer new keys than the new quorum; keys are added only on the strength of kept keys ≥ 7 days old.

No instruction changes the pinned LaunchLab platform / cpConfigId; the registration policy changes only through set_registration_policy (48 h, stranding only, until the cap sunset), which can never select policy 2 (pair curve) — that policy is chosen at initialize_token or not at all.
No PlatformConfig is required: without one, the hard-coded default cap (25 SOL until 2027-10-01) applies, so a lost or finalised upgrade authority cannot wedge buybacks.

upgrade_authority.power: Program upgrade authority (BPF Upgradeable Loader) — outside the IDL, the one power that could change everything above.
upgrade_authority.holder_at_launch: The Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig vault with a 48 h time lock (SetTimeLock 172800), so every upgrade is proposed publicly and waits 48 h before it can execute. The same vault holds the platform authority and, per token, the config authority.
upgrade_authority.sunset: Set to none (`solana program set-upgrade-authority <PROGRAM_ID> --final`, executed through the multisig) after the audit — the program then can never change.
upgrade_authority.verify: docs/burn-receipts/README.md § Deployment runbook: commands, `anchor verify` / `solana-verify` and the expected executable hash.

external_powers.power: LaunchLab platform admin (Raydium LaunchLab PlatformConfig, outside burn_receipts)
external_powers.holder: the key that created the LaunchLab platform — not transferable (no admin-change instruction; the platform PDA is seeded by the admin key)
external_powers.can: updatePlatformConfig: fee rate and wallets — including platformLockNftWallet, which receives every migration's Fee Key (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35: burn_receipts' FEE_KEYS PDA) — cpConfigId, platformCpCreator, LP lock/burn scales (migrateCpLockNftScale; Burnticker: 1,000,000 / 0 / 0, all LP locked), vesting, curve rules — for launches that have not migrated yet.
external_powers.effect_on_burn_receipts: Pinned at initialize_token (review-3 M-3): a later cpConfigId change cannot redirect register_pool (only replace_pool uses the platform's current cpConfigId, after 7 continuous days of a dead pool); platformCpCreator / scales and (LAUNCHPAD-PATH §35) platformLockNftWallet = FEE_KEYS with scales 1,000,000/0/0 are checked at init. Changing them between a token's init and its migration can still strand the registration (recovered with set_registration_policy, 48 h, until the cap sunset) or send that migration's Fee Key — and so its LP fees — to another wallet (the LP itself stays locked; the fees then never reach the burn pool). Since lp-lock blind review r2 (RL-3) such a coin fails closed: register_pool requires the FEE_KEYS-held migration position to be recorded, so its pool is never verified and no buyback runs on it; and initialize_token pins only the operator's compiled BURNTICKER_PLATFORM, whose admin key is the operator's (to move under the Squads vault). LAUNCH GATE (re-check R3-3): immediately before LaunchLab's create the launcher re-reads platformCpCreator, the scales, platformLockNftWallet and cpConfigId and refuses on any difference (`burnreceipts-admin.mts verify-platform-pins --mint`).
